text:
maria_cs: Heads-up — Martek flagged as ‘quiet’ this week. Usage down ~72% last 10d, primary advocate (Tom R.) left last Monday. Saw a procurement RFP pop up mentioning CompetitorX. Could be a renewal risk.

jordan_csm: ugh. thanks for the ping. do we have a timeline on their contract?

maria_cs: renewal in 38d. advocate departure noted in our CRM (Tom removed). No major support tickets, but product feature requests have slowed.

sam_eng: any change in error rates or API 429s? I can run a quick query on infra side.

maria_cs: no spikes in 5xx/429. latency steady. main thing is drop in active seats and embed calls.

sam_eng: ok i'll run this quick script: ```sql
SELECT date, count(distinct user_id) as active_users, sum(tokens) as tokens
FROM events.martech_usage
WHERE account_id='martek'
GROUP BY date
ORDER BY date DESC
LIMIT 14;
```

ana_rev: looping in for commercial context — if procurement is drafting an RFP mentioning CompetitorX we should confirm pricing vs committed usage and offer a short-term credit/accelerator. have we mapped their usage patterns to our pricing tiers?

jordan_csm: not yet. maria, can you confirm who now owns the product decision at Martek?

maria_cs: it's unclear — email thread shows four stakeholders, none responding. I tried DMing their new PM (Lina) but got auto-reply out for PTO.

ops-bot: Reminder: renewals-30d ping sent to @ana_rev and @jordan_csm for account martek.

jordan_csm: propose outreach playbook: 1) 48h personalized touch w/seed credits 2) technical healthcall w/ sam 3) invite to tailored ROI session w/ ana_rev. thoughts? :thinking_face: 

maria_cs: +1. also capture a small eval pack: 2-week dedicated latency profile and cost-savings quickscan from Redwood Optimize. that may neutralize CompetitorX pricing noise.

sam_eng: i can do the healthcall and pull a latency + token breakdown. need a week to prepare traces.

mana_rev: i'll draft a one-pager discount offer and quick ROI deck if we get commitment to a 3-month pilot. can we get usage delta chart and top-10 endpoints used?

maria_cs: adding the ask: top-10 endpoints, spike windows, and last 30d seat churn. will attach to CRM ticket.

jordan_csm: ok let's act fast — i'll schedule the outreach for tomorrow afternoon. maria, you lead the contact. sam and ana, target prep for the healthcall by EOD Tue.

maria_cs: noted. assigning follow-ups in CRM and tagging Martek as "at-risk — churn window". will update thread with customer reply. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: Note: action items recorded: outreach scheduled, healthcall prep, ROI deck.

maria_cs: quick update — Lina replied, available Thu AM. she confirmed procurement is collecting RFPs but is curious about cost/latency tradeoffs.

jordan_csm: great. keep cadence tight. if they ask for pricing, ana and I will field. Sam, bring an example quantization/quant setup that reduces token cost without visible quality drop.

sam_eng: will prepare a short demo and a quantization recommendation.

maria_cs: thanks team. will post meeting notes after Thu and escalate if procurement asks for formal pricing comparison.

jordan_csm: thanks — let’s try to convert this into a short pilot rather than a full rebid. :pray:
